schema.description: ListWarmPoolsResponse is the response for listing warm pools.

items.description:
WarmPool keeps a number of sessions of one configuration booted and idle so
the next session created from it is one of them ("claim") instead of a cold
start. A pool is a stored session-create request — template, session input
values, feature flags, machine and device overrides — plus an owner and a
pool size. The per-session fields (name, labels, auto-terminate,
artifact) are supplied by the claim (CreateSessionRequest.warm_pool_id).

The pool is owned by the principal that owns the claimed sessions: a user
("user") or the workspace itself ("workspace"). User pools are private to
their owner; workspace pools are shared with every member and reachable by
Workspace API Tokens.

cluster.description: Cluster override; empty means resolved from stack + machine type.

createdByEmail.description: Email of the user who created the pool; empty when a Workspace API Token did.

deviceSpec.description:
Device override, with the semantics of CreateSessionRequest.device_spec
relative to the template's declared device. Unset boots the template's
device as declared (or none).

coldBoot.description:
Android only: boot the emulator cold (-no-snapshot-load) and never save a
quickboot snapshot, so every open exercises a full first boot.

cores.description:
Android only: emulator CPU core count. 0 = sized to the host (cores/2,
clamped). Same mint bound + on-VM clamp as ram_mb.

deviceModel.description: Device profile hint (for example, "pixel_7"). Empty = platform default.

osVersion.description:
iOS only: the simulator runtime to boot, as an iOS version such as "18.2"
(or a simctl runtime id). Anything else, and any value on Android, is
rejected. Empty = the newest installed runtime. Reads back as the version.

platform.description:
Device platform: "android" (emulator, Linux stacks) or "ios" (simulator,
macOS stacks).

ramMb.description:
Android only: emulator RAM in MB. 0 = sized to the host (RAM/4, clamped).
Bounded at mint against the machine type's specs; clamped again on the VM
with a degradation notice if the host cannot honor it.

systemImage.description:
Android only: sdkmanager system image package (for example,
"system-images;android-34;google_apis;x86_64"). Empty = platform
default. Images not pre-installed on the stack fall back to the best
installed one with a viewer-visible degradation notice — they are never
downloaded at boot.

enabledFeatureFlagNames.description: Feature flags enabled on the warm sessions.

machineType.description: Machine type override; empty means the template's.

noDevice.description: Create the warm sessions WITHOUT the template's declared device.

ownerId.description:
The owner's identifier, typed by owner_type: the user ID for "user", the
workspace slug for "workspace".

ownerType.description: Who owns the pool and its sessions: "user" or "workspace" (see Session.owner_type).

poolSize.description:
Pool size: how many warm sessions the reconciler keeps booted. 0 drains
the pool (nothing stays booted) and keeps it usable as a preset.

sessionInputs.description:
Session input values the warm sessions are created with. Secret values are
redacted (value empty, is_secret true); saved-input references keep their ID.

items.description:
SessionInputValue provides a value for a session input when creating a session.
Either provide a direct value or reference a saved input by ID (for secrets).

isSecret.description: Whether the value is secret (encrypt at rest). Ignored if saved_input_id is set.

key.description: Key name matching a session input on the template.

savedInputId.description:
Optional: ID of a Saved Input to use. Backend fetches and decrypts the value server-side.
This avoids exposing secret values to the frontend.

value.description: Direct value (used when user typed in a value). Ignored if saved_input_id is set.

stackId.description: Stack override; empty means the template's.

claimedTotal.description: Lifetime number of sessions claimed from the pool.

coldTotal.description:
Lifetime number of sessions created from the pool's configuration
because no warm session was available — the signal that pool_size
is too low for the demand.

configError.description:
Why the stored configuration no longer builds (the template changed under
the pool, a saved input was deleted, a stack was retired); empty when the
configuration is valid. The pool creates nothing until it is fixed.

lastError.description:
The last machine-creation failure (instance-manager quota, capacity, ...);
empty when healthy.

pausedUntil.description: Until when the reconciler backs off after repeated failures; unset when active.

ready.description: Warm sessions that are booted and usable right now.

sessions.description:
The pool's current warm sessions (warming and ready), oldest first.
Filled by GetWarmPool only; empty on list responses.

items.description: WarmPoolSession is one of a pool's warm sessions.

createdAt.description: When the warm session was created.

name.description:
The session's name — the pool's name plus a short random suffix until a
claim renames it.

readyAt.description: When it became ready; unset while warming.

sessionId.description: ID of the session (readable through GetSession by whoever may see the pool).

warming.description: Warm sessions still booting (machine, warmup script, device).

templateId.description: ID of the template every warm session is created from.

templateName.description: Name of that template (empty if the template has since been deleted).

updatedAt.description: When the pool was last updated.
